modules.title: 等待外部响应时，协程怎样挂起并恢复
协程怎样利用 I/O 等待时间

items.title: 问题与关键机制
items.text: 请求等待外部 API 时同步占住执行路径，后续任务只能排队；协程在 await 处保存进度并挂起，以便让出执行权，响应回来后再恢复，让其他协程利用 I/O 等待时间推进。

items.title: 改善看等待是否被重叠
items.text: 加入一个慢响应时，其他协程仍能推进且挂起、恢复有记录，说明 I/O 等待被利用；这不证明 CPU 计算并行或一定更快。

items.title: 聊天附件上传也适合协程
items.text: 聊天应用同时上传多个附件时，每个上传协程可在等待网络响应时挂起；其他上传继续推进，响应回来再恢复。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 协程描述挂起与恢复，不等于线程，也不自动等于并行。它常用于重叠 I/O 等待；CPU 密集工作是否并行取决于调度器、线程和进程配置。

lessonPractice.title: 一个接口要等待三个外部 API，等待期间线程几乎没有计算。哪种改法更符合协程？

options.label: 在等待点挂起当前协程，让执行器先推进其他协程，响应后再恢复
options.feedback: 对。协程用明确暂停点重叠 I/O 等待，不要求每个任务创建新线程。

options.label: 把异步函数都叫协程，并认定每个协程一定运行在独立线程
options.feedback: 协程可以在同一线程交替运行，不等于创建了新线程。

options.label: 把大量 CPU 计算包进协程，就认定它一定会并行变快
options.feedback: 协程本身不提供 CPU 并行，CPU 密集任务仍要考虑调度器和线程或进程资源。

en.title: An endpoint waits for three external APIs and does almost no computation while waiting. Which change uses coroutines appropriately?

options.label: Suspend at waits, let the executor advance other coroutines, then resume on response
options.feedback: Correct. Explicit suspension overlaps I/O waits without requiring a new thread per task.

options.label: Call every async function a coroutine and assume each runs on its own thread
options.feedback: Coroutines can alternate on one thread and do not imply new threads.

options.label: Wrap heavy CPU computation in a coroutine and assume it becomes parallel and faster
options.feedback: Coroutines do not create CPU parallelism; scheduling and thread or process resources still matter.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请把这三个外部 API 调用改成可并发等待的协程：在 I/O 等待处挂起并让出执行，响应回来后恢复并合并结果。记录挂起、恢复和总耗时；再加入一个慢响应，确认其他请求不会被同步等待堵住。不要声称 CPU 密集计算会因此自动变快。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Run these three external API calls as coroutines that suspend during I/O, yield execution, then resume and combine results. Record suspension, resumption, and elapsed time. Add one slow response and verify other work is not blocked by synchronous waiting. Do not claim CPU-heavy work becomes faster automatically.

learning.assumes: You have seen a network request wait for an external response.
learning.outcome: You can recognize coroutine suspension and resumption and distinguish overlapping I/O waits from a claim of CPU parallelism.

modules.title: How a coroutine suspends and resumes around an external wait
How coroutines use I/O wait time

items.title: Problem and key mechanism
items.text: When a request synchronously holds its execution path while waiting for an external API, later work queues behind it; at each await, a coroutine preserves its progress, suspends, and yields execution, then resumes when the response arrives so other coroutines can use the I/O wait time.

items.title: Verify overlapping waits
items.text: With one slow response, other coroutines still advance and suspension is traceable. This does not prove CPU work runs in parallel.

items.title: Chat attachment uploads also suit coroutines
items.text: When a chat app uploads several attachments, each upload coroutine can suspend while waiting on the network. Other uploads continue and the suspended one resumes when its response arrives.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: A coroutine describes suspension and resumption, not a thread or automatic parallelism. It often overlaps I/O waits; CPU parallelism still depends on scheduler, thread, and process configuration.

distinctions.label: Thread
distinctions.text: {c:coroutine} is cooperatively scheduled in user space to overlap I/O wait without creating OS threads; a {c:thread} is preemptively scheduled by the kernel for true multi-core parallel execution.
